extracted.intended_audience: Members of the public and stakeholders (including PPP borrowers, lenders, affected small businesses, researchers, and other interested parties) invited to submit comments on SBA information collections under the Paperwork Reduction Act.
extracted.subtask_description: Submitting public comments to the Small Business Administration on the proposed extension of an information collection (Paycheck Protection Program Affiliation Worksheet, SBA Form 3511) under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Commenters should evaluate necessity, burden estimates, clarity, and potential automation improvements and provide specific suggestions to reduce respondent burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Necessity and practical utility of the information collection
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the information collection is necessary for the proper performance of SBA's functions, including whether it has any practical utility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the notice: 'Commenters should also address (i) whether the information collection is necessary for the proper performance of SBA's functions, including whether it has any practical utility.' Provide reasoned analysis of how the collection supports SBA duties, enforcement, oversight, or other statutory purposes; explain practical uses of the collected data and consequences if the collection did not occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy of estimated burdens
rubrics_metrics.description: The accuracy of the estimated burdens associated with the information collection (e.g., estimated number of respondents, annual responses, and annual hour burden).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the notice: '(ii) the accuracy of the estimated burdens.' Commenters should evaluate and, where possible, provide empirical or reasoned evidence that the burden estimates (e.g., 0 respondents, 0 annual responses, 63 annual hour burden) are correct or suggest corrected estimates with supporting rationale or calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhancing quality, utility, and clarity of the information
rubrics_metrics.description: Ways to enhance the quality, utility, and clarity of the information to be collected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the notice: '(iii) ways to enhance the quality, utility, and clarity of the information to be collected.' Offer concrete recommendations (e.g., question wording changes, response options, instructions, formatting) that would improve data accuracy, reduce confusion, or increase usefulness for SBA and respondents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of automated collection techniques and information technology to minimize burden
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether and how automated collection techniques or other forms of information technology can be used to minimize information collection burden.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the notice: '(iv) the use of automated collection techniques or other forms of information technology to minimize the information collection burden on those who are required to respond.' Recommend specific technological approaches (online forms, integrations with existing systems, pre-population, electronic signatures) and discuss feasibility, costs, privacy/security considerations, and expected burden reduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide specific and detailed suggestions to improve collection and reduce burden
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit specific and detailed suggestions on ways to improve the collection and reduce the burden on respondents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the notice: 'SBA invites the public to submit comments, including specific and detailed suggestions on ways to improve the collection and reduce the burden on respondents.' Comments should be actionable and detailed (e.g., propose alternative fields, remove duplicative questions, estimate time savings) rather than general statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification and reference requirements for submitted comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments should refer to the information collection by title or OMB Control Number (3245-0416) when submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the notice: 'Comments should refer to the information collection by title or OMB Control Number (3245-0416) ...' Ensure submitted comments explicitly identify the collection (title and/or OMB number) so they are associated correctly with the docket and reviewed in context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission channel and contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Where and how to submit comments and how to obtain forms/supporting documents or further information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the notice: 'submitted by the deadline above to: PPP_Info_Collections@sba.gov.' For further information or to obtain copies of the forms and supporting documents contact the Agency Clearance Officer (Curtis Rich) or Cailyn Gerald at the provided phone numbers/emails. Use the PDF linked for the official format when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness / comment deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be submitted on or before the specified closing date (May 19, 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the notice: 'Submit comments on or before May 19, 2025.' Late submissions may not be considered; plan to submit with sufficient time and confirm receipt if possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference to supporting background and justification for extension
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration of the agency's stated reasons and supporting background for the requested extension of the information collection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice provides background explaining why the collection needs extension (e.g., PPP borrowers applying for forgiveness up to five years after loan issuance, SBA reviews, pending litigation, extension of lender recordkeeping requirements). Commenters should evaluate and, if relevant, challenge or support these stated justifications with evidence or argument.
